notes.title: NEW UPDATE COMING UP THIS MONTH!!! New character, New map and New achievements.
notes.notes:
I have great news, I've working in a new update for the game which will include the character Vesta, the demon Mercenary: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045915/e4ee7514cad3148732fdec376db8a84920b39590.png[/img]

and a completely new map with their own set of enemies and music, the Forest Ruins:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045915/cce17a03ba25f07202e7e30ac57bae580eb5cf5b.png[/img]

Here are some of the new enemies you will find, each with their own unique behavior:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045915/567b292894a1b1ddae8d8d465552e6993b458c81.png[/img]

With this update will come new achievements and if all goes well I will also add the Steam cloud feature.

Thanks for reading. Have fun!!!
-RM120

notes.title: Dungeon Watchers 0.2.2 Patch Notes (Rain of Spells achievement fix)
notes.notes: The achievement "Rain of Spells" had a bug that prevented some players from unlocking it after reaching the 1000% or more casting speed. This has been fixed.

notes.title: Dungeon Watchers 0.2.1 Patch Notes (new achievements)
notes.notes:
[b]The following new achievements have been added to the game:[/b]

[list]
[*]PRAISE THE SUN!!! --------> Reach the max level of Fire Nova.
[*]LUCKY WATCHER ----------> Obtain more than 20 luck in a single run.
[*]Mass Destruction ----------> Reach 400% of bonus AoE
[*]Rain of Spells --------------> Reach the excessive amount of 1000% casting speed.
[/list]

notes.title: Dungeon Watchers 0.2.0 Update and upcoming features
notes.notes:
Today I bring a new update which adds new variations to the enemies from the first map (Dark Moor Ruins):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045915/b3764b2f33bc16cdc81950470705b670a190164c.png[/img]

Also, I updated the ghost sprites, and now they blush when they are shy, this is important because it makes them cuter.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045915/67733c9d58eee01376ab1cd4615e73dfb86f2219.png[/img]

In other news, here is a small preview of the new upcoming character with a physical affinity:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045915/ffee76dd420e187a40c275d1f66ab87029e8da5f.png[/img]

I'm working on making her animations and expanding the game's code, since with her new kit, "on-hit effects" and "on-death effects" are coming to the game, which will allow for more synergies with spells, weapons, and summons. After finishing this character, I'll work on the other two that have electric and ice affinities. After that, I'll work on the 3rd map.

A small update will be coming this weekend adding new achievements.

Thanks for reading. Have fun!!!
-RM120

notes.title: Dungeon Watchers 0.1.3 Patch Notes (skill tags)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Now, on the level-up screen, weapons, spells, and summons will display tags below their names that inform about the properties of the power.
[/list]
This is a small update, but this week will come another one (0.2.0) with new variations for the enemies on the first map and new achievements. This update will also share info on the new character.

notes.title: Dungeon Watchers 0.1.2 Patch Notes (UltraWide support)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]The UI (menu and buttons) when played in a ultrawide resolution, which made difficult to navigate a select characters and power ups. Now the game scales this elements properly and should be working fine.
[/list]
On an additional note, currently I am working on adding tags to the weapons/spells/summons, so the players can know with more clarity the properties of them. For example:

FIRE ORBS
Spell - Fire - Projectile

ICE AURA
Spell - Ice - AOE

This mini update will come with new achievements and information on the new character I'm working on, stay tuned.

notes.title: Dungeon Watchers 0.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Add the option to disable chromatic aberration in the Options menu.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Iris's unique skills to not display their descriptions correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Spark Orbs to not level up correctly.
[*] Added a white outline to enemy projectiles to make them easier to see on screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Dungeon Watchers Demo - Update 0.0.5
notes.notes:
[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gem experience amount increased from 3 to 4.5 points.
[*] Casting Speed Power up increased from 30% to 40%.
[*] Critical chance Power up increased from 2% to 4%.
[*] Critical damage Power up increased from 40% to 60%.
[*] The medium and small slimes now drop gems too.
[*] The projectiles from the Gazers now only have a duration of 4 seconds instead of 7.
[*] Damage reduced for slimes.
[*] The speed of the small green devil balls at around 9:00 has been reduced.
[/list]
[h1]Misc & fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Gazer's projectiles now create a hit visual effect when they hit the player.
[/list]
This changes have the intention of making the game more easier because there is only one map with only the first difficulty... higher difficulties will need investment on upgrades and rings (meta-progression) which will be available in the Early Access version.

If you play the demo, please give feedback, so I can know for sure what are the experiences of the player, which is important for me as a developer and the future of the game.

Thank you for reading and play... have fun!!!
-RM120
